chunks: Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn Ishaq, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Raja, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Good neighborliness increases sustenance.

key_terms.حَسَنُ الْجَوَارِ: Good neighborliness / Excellence in neighborly conduct

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of being a good neighbor according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Kitab al-Zuhd*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the ethical practice of *hasan al-jawar* (good neighborliness) directly to the expansion of *rizq* (divine sustenance), reflecting the Shia emphasis on social ethics as a means of spiritual and material blessing. This narration underscores that neighborly rights are not merely social obligations but are integral to one's spiritual economy and divine favor.
